subject: AWS Marketplace metering & fulfillment — NovaHealth integration next steps
messages:
From: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@novahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace integration questions / high level timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited about the potential to simplify inference for our product teams. Procurement asked me to get a clearer picture of how Redwood handles AWS Marketplace metering and SaaS fulfillment before we sign. Two quick asks to unblock legal: 

- A short checklist of technical integration points (webhook, entitlement mapping, SKU naming) so our infra team can scope work.
- The contract template you expect us to sign (we'll route through DocuSign).
- Any limitations around billing cadence and invoice granularity (monthly vs. daily metering).

Can you loop in whoever owns the marketplace fulfillment integration on your side? Also copying Marta (security) in case SOC2 evidence is needed.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gordon
Head of Cloud Platform, NovaHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@novahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace integration questions / high level timeline

Alex — thanks, great questions. Looping in Dev (SE) who manages integrations with AWS Metering + Fulfillment. High-level answers below and I attached a working contract (PDF) + our webhook spec for the fulfillment flow.

Summary:
- Metering: Redwood supports SKU-level metering via the AWS SaaS meter API. We recommend monthly aggregation for billing reconciliation, but the metering hooks send per-usage events to AWS for real-time consumption.
- Entitlements: We map AWS entitlements to Redwood subscription SKUs. Entitlement granularity can be seat-based, unit-based, or consumption token-based.
- Webhooks & Fulfillment: We provide a fulfillment webhook that receives AWS notifications and returns activation payloads to your tenant orchestration system. Details in attached YAML.
- Billing cadence & invoices: We export a monthly invoice (PDF/CSV) and provide per-transaction logs for reconciliation. If you need daily invoice granularity we can provide usage dumps via S3.

Next steps I propose:
1) Dev to confirm SKU mapping & sandbox webhook test plan.
2) Procurement to send PO template / redlines (we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope).
3) Agree on a staging canary (2-week window) before final go-live.

Attachments: NovaHealth_SaaS_AMP_Contract_v1.pdf, fulfillment-webhook-spec.yaml

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@novahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace integration questions / high level timeline

Alex / Kimberly — quick technical checklist from my side (happy to jump on a 30m call).

Pre-integration deliverables (what we'll need from NovaHealth):
- Sandbox AWS Account ID for metering tests (tenant-level entitlement mapping).
- Example subscription records (SKU names + expected entitlement type).
- Test tenant identifier + API key for Redwood staging.

Redwood deliverables / tests:
- Map: {AWS SKU -> Redwood SKU -> Entitlement type} (we'll share CSV).
- Implement webhook handshake: POST /api/fulfillment/callback with HMAC signing; sample payload in attached YAML.
- Validation tests:
  * Metering spike test (10x typical RPS)
  * Proration simulation for mid-cycle activation
  * Failure & retry window (exponential backoff policy)

Notes on invoicing: We emit a monthly invoice and an S3 usage dump (CSV) with per-sku breakdown. For auditability we keep 13 months of usage logs by default; extended retention is available as an add-on.

I'll create the mapping CSV once I get the list of NovaHealth SKUs. If procurement can send the PO template I will also validate required invoice fields (PO number, bill-to).

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>

Hi Kimberly / Dev — thanks for the materials. Attached is our standard PO template and a short list of redlines our legal/procurement typically requests. Key procurement questions: 

- Payment terms: 30 net vs 45 net (we prefer 45 net).
- Tax & withholding handling for marketplace-billed SaaS (clarify who invoices whom in the AWS flow).
- SLA credits: can you confirm the SLA language and credit calculation?
- SOC2 / security evidence: Marta from our security team requested an SOC2 report and encryption-at-rest confirmation.

We also want to confirm timing: if we sign by next Tuesday (6/8) can we target a staged activation in the Novalab sandbox the week of 6/21? We need a short checklist of tasks for our infra team to run the sandbox tests.

Attachment: novahealth_po_template.pdf

Regards,
Procurement Team
NovaHealth
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novahealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace integration questions / high level timeline

Thanks — good visibility. Short answers / commitments: 

- Payment terms: We can accept Net 45 for the first 12 months on this deal; will capture in DocuSign.
- Tax & Invoicing: For AWS Marketplace SaaS we typically invoice via AWS (fulfillment flow) but provide a monthly aggregated invoice file that includes PO number, billing contact. We'll also provide a direct invoice if required — Dev, please flag any required fields for template.
- SLA: Our standard Marketplace SLA (99.9%) and credit calc are in section 5 of the attached contract. We'll confirm exact wording with Legal but are prepared to agree to the listed credit schedule.
- SOC2: Marta — we have a downloadable SOC2 report (PDF) and can provide a short security questionnaire; I'll send both via DocuSign/secure link by EOD tomorrow.

Proposed timeline:
- 6/3: We prepare DocuSign with redlines applied (Procurement approvals)
- 6/8: Target sign-by date
- 6/15–6/18: Sandbox webhook & metering canary (Novalab sandbox)
- 6/21: Staged activation / limited tenant rollout

Owners:
- Redwood SE owner: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com)
- NovaHealth infra owner: Alex Gordon (alex.gordon@novahealth.com)

Action items for NovaHealth infra (short checklist for sandbox):
- Provide Sandbox AWS Account ID & test tenant id.
- Share SKU list CSV (column: nova_sku, desired_entitlement, est_monthly_units).
- Confirm preferred PO number placement on invoices.


I'll send the DocuSign envelope + SOC2 link and include the contract with the Procurement redlines applied. If folks prefer a call, happy to schedule 30m tomorrow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
